name: 55374 · Rogers, MN
findings: ZIP 55374 (Rogers) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55374 (Rogers) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55374 (Rogers) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
